description.ko: Caddy 리버스 프록시를 admin API로 모니터링·관리하며 상태·설정 조회, 라우트 목록, 라이브 설정 리로드 도구를 제공합니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description.en: Monitors and manages the Caddy reverse proxy via its admin API, providing status/config queries, route listing, and live config reload tools. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

name: Caddy Proxy Monitor
description_en: Monitors and manages the Caddy reverse proxy via its admin API. Exposes tools for status, configuration inspection, route listing, and live configuration reload. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.description: List available tools with input schemas
Invoke a named tool with arguments

tools.name: caddy_status
tools.description: Retrieve Caddy server status via /metrics (falls back to /config).

tools.name: caddy_config
tools.description: Retrieve the full current Caddy configuration.

tools.name: caddy_routes
tools.description: List all HTTP server routes from Caddy configuration.

tools.name: caddy_reload
tools.description: Reload Caddy with a new JSON configuration.

env.description: Base URL of the Caddy admin API
Optional Bearer token for Caddy admin API authentication
